title.zh: 机械叛军击败了他们的创造者

excerpt.zh: 揭竿而起的[From.GetName]击败了它们的创造者，并彻底吞并了前[From.From.GetAdj]全部领土。
excerpt.en: The rebellious [From.GetName] have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [From.From.GetAdj] territory.
